title: Unit Event — Knowing the Unseen

meta.Outline: Ena debates whether she should aim for art school post-graduation. With this inner turmoil comes restlessness, which begins to affect her art. Mr. Yukihira notices that she's struggling, and after she divulges the cause, he invites her to take part in an excursion.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Okay, these shadows look fine...
All that's left is to even out the shading...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I feel like I was able to finish a lot faster compared to yesterday. But I'm still having trouble getting it to look three-dimensional...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(I'll draw another one while I'm at it...
I should focus on creating more depth by being more careful with the lines I draw this time.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I'm here! I think Enanan also is...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<But she's on mute.
Maybe she isn't here right at this moment...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Is everything okay? If there's something you need to do, it's fine for you to focus on that.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <No, that's okay. I just reached a good place to stop, so I'll start working on what I was doing yesterday.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I wanna practice doing sketches a little more, but I also don't want to cut corners with N25...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I can get back to what I was doing once I've finished working on what I need to today.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I need to draw as much as possible, and do it with care. I have to get better.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No. For now, I just need to work harder.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(I got an earful again today...
But I guess that to be expected since I'll still not up to par.)

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: I really liked the still-life drawing you made today, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: Yeah. The glass you drew looked so real, and you did such a good job with that lemon's shadow. It felt really three-dimensional.

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: Plus, Mr. Yukihira didn't seem to have any complaints regarding those things.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Thank goodness. I feel like I'm starting to get better at doing sketches.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (My progress has been slow, but it's good to know that I'm improving. And I just gotta keep trying...)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Lastly, I have an announcement to make.

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: What do think he's going to talk about?

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: As I do each year, I'll be holding a special course on technical mastery for those aiming to get into art school.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: I strongly suggest to all prospective applicants to not pass up this opportunity.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (His course on technical mastery and getting into art school...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (He works individually with each of his students, right? Sketches, oil paintings, everything...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Each year many of his students get accepted because they took this course.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (If I'm serious about getting into art school, then I should take this opportunity to get him to teach me one-on-one.)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Those who are interested will have until next month to let me know. For now, good work today.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Welcome home.
Dinner will be ready soon.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Okay...
I'm going up to my room to change.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I really need to make up my mind about that soon.)

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: How are things for your exhibit coming along, dear?

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, that's wonderful to hear.
I might have to stop by if I get a chance.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: You're going to have quite a few of your older works on display, yes?

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: This exhibit's sort of meant to be the culmination of my life's work up until now.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'll be looking forward to it.
And I'm sure all the other visitors are also going to enjoy it very much.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Getting to create art for a living... Having the masses see and appreciate your work...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I'm having trouble seeing myself being able to doing that.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I've been drawing every day since I decided that I'm going to improve one step at a time. But everyone else is still miles ahead of me...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Do I even need to go to art school in the first place?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(If I want to get better...
If I really do want to become an artist, then I probably should.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But can someone like me really do this for a living?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Is it okay for me to even apply when I'm feeling like this...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh... Nothing's wrong.
I'm gonna go get changed now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Okay, my drawing of this statue has nice some depth to it...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But I seem to be making the same mistake again. It looks crooked just like last time...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I see now. The length of each part is uneven which is why it feels imbalanced.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I've been practicing what he's been telling me to do, but I can't figure out how to make them second nature...)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: As I do each year, I'll be holding a special course on technical mastery for those aiming to get into art school.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But can someone like me really do this for a living?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Is it okay for me to even apply when I'm feeling like this...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I can't focus. My head's a complete mess...)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: The outline of your statue looks lopsided, Shinonome. Are you having trouble focusing?

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: So, to summarize, you need to observe your subject as much as possible and put that to paper. This is one of the most fundamental components of art.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: You seemed to completely miss that today. You can hone your craft all you want, but it'll be all for naught if your fundamentals aren't sound.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Also, you seemed to lose focus partway through. Is there something on your mind...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm wondering if I should try to get into an art school.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Tell me this. Why do you wish to go to art school...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I want to become a better artist...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I want to do that and become a professional artist.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: I have a proposal for you.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Next weekend, let's have a special lesson outside of class.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What? You're helping with a solo exhibit?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, as part of a special lesson for my art class.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: To be fair, it's gonna be just me and Mr. Yukihira.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Uhh... Is it different from the ones they do at art museums?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, your standard art exhibit usually involves displaying various works revolving around a certain theme...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But a solo exhibit involves the works of just one artist.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
So many paintings...
This is amazing.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: There's stuff other than paintings too.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, some solo exhibits focus on sculptures or other inanimate objects. It all depends on what the artist wants to express.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's pretty cool how you can get a glimpse of what's going on inside the artist's head based on what they put on display!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, what are your tasks going to involve?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hmm, could be a number of things...
But since they've already picked out a venue and what to put on display, I'll probably be helping move the paintings and putting up decorations.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That sounds like a lot of physical work...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah...
I really wanna see what it looks like once all the paintings are put up.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, Ena, can we come see it...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But this is his... My dad's exhibit...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Are you sure you're gonna be okay?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I think so, but I'm not really looking forward to it...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
...?
Is it bad that you're helping your dad with his exhibit...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Bad isn't quite it... It's just that, we have some history between us...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Don't worry about me.
I'll probably be fine.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Again, I'm not looking forward to it...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But there must be a reason why my teacher offered to give me a special lesson, so I don't wanna pass up this opportunity.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'll probably be helping set everything up in the morning. Rin, Len, you two can come over whenever during that time.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Mhm... Just five more minutes...
I stayed up really late working last night...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I'm supposed to meet Mr. Yukihira at half past eight in front of the exhibit hall...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: A hall full of his paintings...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I don't know what he's been up to lately, but I'm sure he's been producing some amazing stuff.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (And his exhibit's probably going to be packed with people.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What?! You two are already here?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <You did say that you'd be going in the morning.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No, you're fine...
Now I feel like I should go.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Don't worry about that.
Anyway, you guys will need to wait a bit while I get ready.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thank you for having me today.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Of course. We're here today because your father was kind enough to allow us to help set up his exhibit. I'm hoping this will be a good learning opportunity for you.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: However, you are not here today as his daughter, but as my student. I will be treating you as I always do, so please keep that in mind.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Still, are you sure about this...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: My dad probably won't be very happy if he sees me here...

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
That won't be a problem.
Again, your father already knows that we'll be present.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I feel like he wouldn't want me to be around his art, though...)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Oh, before we get to work...

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Mr. Shinonome, does the current angle of the lighting on the artwork look alright to you?

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line:
Yes, they look good...
Let's go with that.

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
Understood.
Now, if you'll excuse me.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Thank you for having us on such short notice. I really appreciate you allowing me to hold a special lesson here today.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: I'm very much looking forward to your exhibit, and I promise to make this a fruitful experience for my student.

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: Yukihira, do you have to be so formal about this...? It honestly feels a little strange...

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: I'm here on business after all.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: So, once again, thank you for having us here today.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: U-Uhh... Thank you for having us.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I can never tell what he's thinking...)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
But that's a separate matter.
For now, let's get our lesson started.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: The person over in the corner is the exhibition team leader. We'll be working alongside the others as staff members, so let's go see what work needs to be done.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay, I think this painting goes over here... Put up the label and...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(This is pretty hard work...
I'm just putting up the paintings according to these plans, but they're heavy...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (It's been a while since I've looked at his paintings...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (You can tell at a glance that there's something special about them.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Your eyes are immediately drawn to each subject. It's almost like they're able to dive right into your mind.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(And the colors he uses are so beautiful...
So beautiful that you don't even think about the technical aspects of it.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Wow... Did your dad paint this, Ena?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I mean, he is a professional artist.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Ena... Do you not like your dad's art?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's not that I dislike his art.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I used to really love his paintings so much that I tried to copy what he did.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Seeing his paintings reminds me of the truth.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (That I don't have what it takes...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (So, is it really okay for me to...)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: How are things coming along on your end, Shinonome?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I've got everything set up here.
I just need to clean, and then I'll be done.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
I see.
So, what can you tell me about this painting?

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Were you able to learn anything from your father's work?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Um, I'm sorry.
I didn't pay much attention to it while setting it up.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: In that case, let's examine it together.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
This painting...
Can you tell me what it's about?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's titled “A Peony Blooming in the Night”...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: If I recall, the night I was born, he saw a single peony blooming on his way home from the hospital. So, he decided to draw it.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: What you just told me is simply the backstory.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
That is not what I'm talking about.
I was asking what you felt after seeing this painting.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
Yes.
I'd like for you to think about what you feel as you look at each of these paintings with your own eyes.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: To see what they're really about.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: I will take care of the rest of your duties.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I honestly don't want to go around looking at his stuff...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Because each one is a reminder of how far I am from his caliber.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But if this is what Mr. Yukihira wants me to do, then I might be able to find whatever it is that I've been missing...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(I have to do this.
I have to take a hard look at his art...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sorry, Len, Rin. I know you guys are worried about me.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I'm gonna go around to look.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <B-But... Don't push yourself too hard, okay?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Anyway, I'm thinking about starting from the beginning, so let's go over there.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (All of his paintings are overwhelmingly good...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (The framing and even the application of the colors are innovative...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <This painting of a river at night... It feels so strange and surreal. Almost like something out of a dream...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, yeah. The river in this painting's actually right near my house.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, unlike how it's depicted, it's actually a pretty ordinary place. I tried painting it one time, but it didn't turn out very well.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And yet, with him, it turns into this...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Also, I know I'm supposed to see how it makes me feel, but I really don't know.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I understand all the technical aspects behind it, like how he's framed the river in a way to make it look bigger...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <But it feels kinda dark for some reason...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah, a lot of them seem to take place at night...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm guessing it's because the theme of this exhibit is “Deep in the Night”. Hence all these night paintings.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, it's just... I think when he drew these plays a big role in terms of what sort of impression they give off.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: The paintings at the beginning take place at night, but they seem to focus more on a source of light, like the moon or the streetlamps.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, they didn't feel that dark.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
But the ones on this wall...
The pieces in this period don't give off the same impression.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hmm... How do I put it...?
I can't place my finger on it, but they feel a lot darker for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <A dark room with empty cans and paint everywhere...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<That's a canvas, right...?
It's on the ground for whatever reason...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I remember seeing this one when I was little...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. He had it in his studio.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But he sorta leered at me when I saw it, and immediately put it away afterwards...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I guess he didn't want you to see it.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Come to think of it, this painting...
His brush strokes look a lot rougher.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: His style had always been pretty rough. I mean, you can basically see each brush stroke...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
But this painting...
This goes beyond that. It's like he was all over the place.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Was he feeling pressured? Maybe he was in pain or something...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, like nothing mattered to him anymore.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But he felt that he needed to keep painting...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I have to draw something... Anything!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But if I lose my ability to draw, then I'd really...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Why am I so bad at this...?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I drew stuff in the same way back then.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (After he told me I should give up on my dream, I drew and drew as much as I could... But I wasn't able to produce anything good. I was in a state of panic. I didn't know what to do...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(His painting turned out better...
But I felt the chaos I'm seeing here...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <What if your dad was having trouble painting, Ena?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Still, I am sensing pain in this picture.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I'm jealous of how he can paint like this...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(So, what made him draw this...?
Something that looks like pain and suffering...)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: I'd like for you to think about what you feel as you look at each of these paintings with your own eyes.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: To see what they're really about.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I don't know. I can't say for sure...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But I have to look at it and see how I feel minus all assumptions or extraneous information.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Then, I might be able to find the answer...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (It feels less dark compared to the others.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (The previous piece had really dark shadows. With paint everywhere and the canvas on the ground... It was like nothing mattered anymore to him...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (A moonbeam is illuminating this peony. As though it's giving it life.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (It looks quite messy, despite the peony itself being painted carefully.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<There's something off about this painting...
The flower's really pretty, but everything else is so dark.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <What do you think was going through your dad's mind when he painted this, Ena...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But unlike those other paintings we just saw, this one involves a source of light...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. It's hard to ignore the shadows and darkness, but he seemed to put a lot of effort into this beam of light...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But if his goal was to paint something about light, I feel that he would've done something different...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (What was going through his mind when he painted this...?)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
How are things going?
What do you feel when you see this painting...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: This peony's pretty, but everything else around it feels like it was painted in a frenzy...

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
Yes...?
Just try to say what comes to mind.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I noticed something after seeing all his paintings up to this period...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: For some reason, his works from around this time all seem to evoke pain and suffering...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
But he feels that he has to keep drawing.
That's sort of what I got out of them...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: This painting... In the midst of the pain, there's also...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: A sense of hope or something similar... I think that's what it's trying to express...

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: I see. That's what you felt when you saw this?

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: There was a time when he struggled to overcome a massive creative block.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: I still to this day vividly remember the state he was in.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: He'd finally begun his journey as a painter, but no one seemed interested in looking at his art, let alone understand it.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: He drew and drew as much as he could. He was so desperate.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: I even heard that he was struggling to make ends meet. Things got so hard that his wife had to support him and put food on the table...

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Then, one day, she gave birth to a baby girl.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: That was when he began asking himself...

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
“Can I keep going on like this?”
“Should I give up on being an artist?”

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
He decided to do one last painting.
A piece called “A Peony Blooming in the Night”.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
Yes, but...
As you know, he didn't end up quitting.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: I don't fully understand the pain he felt or how he figured out what he needed to do.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: I do know that he decided to fully commit himself to his art.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
Now then, the exhibit's about to open.
Why don't we end our lesson here?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Would it be okay if I stayed a little while longer...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I want to take another look at the artwork...

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
I don't mind.
But I'll be excusing myself here.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: This is where Ena's dad is holding his art exhibit?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I always thought solo exhibitions took place at smaller venues... I guess it just means he's that famous.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I can't wait to see what's inside!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The theme for this exhibit is “Deep in the Night”, so the art we're going to see may all have something to do with that...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, really?!
Wait, Mafuyu, you knew beforehand?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Kanade seemed interested, so we did some research.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'd seen some of Ena's dad's works in the past, so I've been looking forward to this a little...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. Then, I'm glad we came!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Where do you think Ena is...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, good question.
I was under the impression that she'd be by the reception...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But we may have a hard time finding her since she's also supposed to be helping out behind the scenes...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But it'd still be nice to see her.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I mean, Ena really doesn't like having anything to do with her dad.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <What if your dad was having trouble painting, Ena?>

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: He'd finally begun his journey as a painter, but no one seemed interested in looking at his art, let alone understand it.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: He drew and drew as much as he could. He was so desperate.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (There was a time when nobody would look at his art...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I'm having a hard time believing that...)

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: But if you're serious about becoming a professional, you'll keep facing what you are now time and time again.

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: The difference between those with talent and those without is that those without have to work much harder to be on the same level. More than you can imagine...

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: I'm saying that you'll keep feeling this pain if you choose to continue drawing...

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: You won't always be able to produce works that satisfy you. Can you deal with that pain moving forward?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(He struggled to produce anything that he was satisfied with.
The thought of not being able to create art agonized him.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (He felt pain with each brush stroke, which was only made worse by people not showing any interest in what he was doing.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (And yet, he chose to keep creating...)

rows.Speaker: Visitor A
rows.Line:
Shinonome's such an amazing artist.
All of his paintings are just so wonderful...!

rows.Speaker: Visitor B
rows.Line: Based on the theme of this exhibit, I will say that there are a lot of dark and gloomy pieces... But they're all really beautiful.

rows.Speaker: Visitor A
rows.Line:
I agree.
It's no wonder that he's hailed as a modern master. He's produced a fabulous feast for our eyes.

rows.Speaker: Visitor A
rows.Line: With “A Peony Blooming in the Night” as the piece de resistance. It's just so beautiful...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I always saw this one as just another pretty painting...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (There was something mystical about this peony blooming while surrounded by darkness.)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
Yes, but...
As you know, he didn't end up quitting.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: I don't fully understand the pain he felt or how he figured out what he needed to do.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: I do know that he decided to fully commit himself to his art.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: He decided to fully commit himself to his art...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (What state of mind was he in...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (How was he able to actually do that...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Ena has a serious look on her face...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: By the looks of things, I think we have nothing to worry about.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, let's give her some space for now.

rows.Speaker: Staff Members
rows.Line:
Congratulations, Mr. Shinonome.
The visitors seemed really enjoy your exhibit.

rows.Speaker: Staff Members
rows.Line: I'll be looking forward to seeing you again tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thanks for letting me help today.

rows.Speaker: Staff Members
rows.Line:
Thank you for being here!
I also wish you good luck moving forward!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Besides, doesn't he have anything to say to me for helping out today? Sure, I came as part of a special lesson, but I at least deserve a thank you.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
(Maybe trying to go home at the same time wasn't such a good idea...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: There's something I wanna ask you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Is it true that you thought about giving up on painting around the time I was born...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I sorta got a feeling after seeing your paintings today...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I always thought you had a lot of confidence in your art. But the paintings I saw today seemed to be filled with pain and anguish...

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: Back then, I ended up drawing things that people wanted to see because no one understood what I actually wanted them to see...

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line:
I hated myself for appeasing them.
But I didn't give up. I clung to my brush and kept drawing what I wanted.

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: Even then, no one understood... I felt despair...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Which is why you wanted to quit?

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: Back then, I wasn't trying to be an artist. I was just another human trying to make it to the next day...

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: At that point in my life, I'd achieved nothing as neither a man nor an artist.

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: I was a hopeless person who was just floating around aimlessly.

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: Before then, I felt like I was wandering around in the dark.

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: But when I held you in my arms for the first time, I saw a glimmer of light...

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: It felt like I finally had something I needed to protect and cherish.

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: The man who couldn't create or achieve anything felt compelled to keep you safe as your fellow human being.

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: Which is why I decided to make one last painting before ending my career as an artist...

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: I still vividly remember what I saw while walking home from the hospital that night. That flower.

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: It was so small and all by itself in the darkness. It felt like a newborn baby, just like the one I held only moments before.

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: It felt right for me to turn it into my last painting. It was the small flicker of light that illuminated my miserable existence...

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: And so, I put everything into that painting.

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: But after I finished painting it...

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: I couldn't bring myself to break all of my brushes.

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: I put everything I had into that painting...

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: Everything I loved and hated about art. All the joy and pain I felt. That's what went into it.

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: It made me think why was I so ready to give up on my art?

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: Even though I knew I wouldn't be able to...

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: That was when I finally realized...

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: I can't live without art in my life.

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: And then it dawned on me.

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: I realized that I wouldn't be able to live life without creating art. Which also meant that I wouldn't be able to protect what mattered most.

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: So, I decided to keep on living without letting it go.

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: That's when I was able to fully commit myself to my art...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (What if I let go of my art...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I'd still be able to go shopping, take selfies, chat with everyone about stuff... I'd get to have fun while doing whatever. Maybe even drawing simple illustrations from time to time...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Is that what I want my life to be?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I wouldn't be me without my art.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I'd never forgive myself if I tossed it all aside...)

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: It made me think why was I so ready to give up on my art?

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: Even though I knew I wouldn't be able to...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (No matter how much I think or suffer, I can't get myself to give up...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I know how I need to live my life now.

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: How you need to live your life...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I know I don't have talent.
Most of the things I draw aren't very good, and nothing's going to change at this rate.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I can't see myself not drawing...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, I'm going to draw and draw and keep drawing!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And one day... I will become an artist.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I know!
I don't stand a chance against the real geniuses out there by just working hard. Even if I do become an artist, I'm probably going to suffer a lot...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I probably still don't fully understand what I'm up against... But I did learn something after seeing your paintings today...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I learned that I can't quit doing art...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I don't know if it's because I'm your daughter or if it's because I've been surrounded by art my entire life... But I can't live without it!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, at least give me this...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Let me take responsibility for my own life.

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: You're prepared to make that commitment...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (The road up ahead is probably gonna be really rough...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(I'm going to suffer creating just like him...
No, I'd say even more...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But I can't run away from my art...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Because that's the only path for me.)
